svg.text: East node - full site | Hebron, KY
Building on its parcel with truck courts both sides. Roughly 7.6 acres. Inbound court west, outbound court east with trailer storage, staff parking to the front.
Grid squares are 25 ft. Truck courts at 130 and 150 ft give 53 ft trailers room to turn and back. 44 staff spaces shown.
